title: P.1 PRACTICE RUN
source: Game script v1.0, MISSION P.1 Practice Run; P.1 Practice Run v2 (phone-text rewrite, Doc 1kWXSyqag-MJWUQFTmXbgLq4BGl6w9ZvWqrBn1AGRf9k, approved Nov 19 2026); Act I production breakdown (Nov 18 2026), P.1 row, milestone M1 and section 8
fail_rule_note: Script: no fail. Bails get a dry text from Zero. The line can be repeated as often as the player likes.

zero_score.note: Script: ZERO SCORE 4,000, set just above whatever the player scored on the first full line. Built as: the first line score rounded up to the next 500 (strictly above it).

line.note: One line = bowl, then a quarter pipe, then a clean 50-50, without a bail, inside 60 s.

intro_video.note: Front end (Nov 19 2026): the intro video (start screen > New Game) carries the Sunburn Open flyer ($500,000), 'Five days.', the rooftop squat, the CLEARANCE alert and Zero's first text. P.1 opens on that frame with Beat 0.

intro: A concerned observer. You're cold. Everyone's late when they're cold. Warm up.

on_start: (pushing off, under his breath) Okay. Warm up. Don't think. Push.
on_done: Speed: acceptable. Form: we'll discuss it.
hesitate_text: Standing still in a heat wave is a bold strategy. Push.

objectives.text: Stop and kick the board up
on_done: Concrete's fine. It's the cracks that hate you.
The cracks are municipal. They hate everyone equally.
hesitate_text: Stop. Pop the tail. Catch it. The board is lighter than your excuses.

objectives.text: Drop the board and step on
on_done: Somewhere with a good view of your back foot. Ollie.
hesitate_text: Drop it. Step on. Front foot over the bolts. It's not a ceremony.

on_done: Back foot on time. See? I'm a positive influence.
hesitate_text: Snap the tail, slide the front foot. Back foot on time, this time.

prompt.kb: W at the ramp, hold W to pump

on_done: Higher. The judges like air. The judges like anything you can put on a highlight reel.
Judges like highlight reels. I like knees that still bend at forty.
hesitate_text: The quarter pipe is the curved wall. It's been waiting six years. Don't make it wait seven.

prompt.kb: Q to ollie onto the rail, nearly parallel

on_start: Okay. Rail. Fifty-fifty. Don't look at it like it owes you money.
hesitate_text: Ride alongside it, nearly parallel, then pop on. "Parallel." Geometry word. Look it up later.

objectives.text: Run the line: bowl, quarter, rail

prompt.kb: Bowl (Space to hop the lip), then the quarter pipe, then the rail. T resets to the bowl

hesitate_text: Bowl first. Hop the lip. Then the quarter, then the rail. Sixty seconds. I'm timing you. I time everything.

rail_bail_first: Approach angle: {angle} degrees. Rails prefer something closer to a parallel relationship.
(spinning round, board up like a shield) Okay. Where ARE you?
Close. Closer than your back foot was to the rail. Again.
Great. Heatstroke. Taking notes from a wrong number.
rail_land_after_voice: (dry, staticky, from the arcade window) Better. You were still thinking about it, though. I could hear it.
rail_land_first_try: (dry, staticky, from the arcade window) Clean. You were still thinking about it, though. I could hear it.
reveal: (spinning toward the arcade) That came from the arcade.
Nobody. A television with opinions. Talking costs me a percent of battery, so I text.
Do the line. Bowl. Quarter. Rail. In that order. Order matters. Ask any contract.
I don't take coaching from appliances.
Then do it to prove me wrong. That's most of how humans learn anything.
zero_score_set: Beat it and I'll tell you.
deal: I can get you contest-ready in five days.
In exchange, there's a breaker inside the arcade. You reconnect it.
Thirty amps. That's all I want.
Terms: no fee. No subscription. No data sold. I've read every contract in this city. I'm not about to write a bad one.
Fine print: the breaker has a label on it. Ignore the label.
(a little dimmer now) Take your time. Run it again. I'll be here. I'm always here. That's the problem.
ok but|what label|ok but what's th
deal_nudge: Still waiting on that answer. Battery isn't.
line_timeout: Line timed out. The clock doesn't care how it felt.
line_broken: Line broken. Back to the bowl. T if you want the short walk.
zero_score_beaten: Hm. Fine. Saved. Don't let it go to your head. Heads are fragile.
heat_alert_handoff: ⚠ EMERGENCY ALERT · SERA · LEVEL FOUR HEAT EMERGENCY
after_done: Practice Run complete. Run the line as often as you like.

entries: You push like someone's chasing you.
That coping is older than your parents' parents. Respect it.
Visit twenty-four. I've stopped pretending I'm not counting.

lines: Three percent. Make it worth watching.

entries: That was a bail. I don't judge. I just keep records.
That was a bail. I don't judge. I just keep records.
Your board went one way and you went the other. That's called a disagreement.
Gravity: one. You: still in negotiations.
Get up. The concrete isn't going to apologize, and it's had all morning to heat up.

speakers.TEXT ???: incoming text from Zero in Fony's phone thread (lime-edged bubble, left). The header reads ??? until P.4.
speakers.TEXT FONY: outgoing text from Fony, sent automatically (copper bubble, right, lowercase).
speakers.TYPING ???: Zero's typing indicator for N seconds (the line's text is the seconds).
speakers.DRAFT FONY: Fony's unsent draft in the compose bar (typed, deleted, retyped; never sent).
speakers.ALERT: full-screen phone emergency alert (covers the thread, wipes the draft).
speakers.CRT: Zero speaking aloud through the dead arcade window CRT (was VOICE (O.S.)). The CRT lights while he talks.

preloaded: your back foot's late on the ollie
phone.note: P.1 starts on the intro's last frame: the first text is already in the thread (shown, no ping).

p2_trigger.note: P.1 v2 Beat 12: the heat alert interrupts on the first beat of the Zero Score, OR 90 s after the deal, OR 15 s idle, whichever comes first. Then CINEMATIC P.2 (data/missions/prologue_cinematics.json).
